items.title: Church first
items.text: His mother and his aunt are lifelong gospel singers, and the family sang at church in Brooklyn. He joined in at two.

items.title: Sam Cooke, on a gala stage
items.text: At five he sang Sam Cooke at the NAACP Freedom Fund awards gala in New York.

items.title: A cover Jay-Z used
items.text: He posted a cover of Nina Simone’s “Feeling Good.” It went viral and was sampled at the start of the video for Jay-Z’s “4:44.”

items.title: Twice on *Little Big Shots*
items.text: He sang “For Every Mountain” on the season three premiere of the NBC show, then came back to sing “O Holy Night” on its holiday special.

items.title: *The View*, with Yolanda Adams
items.text: For Martin Luther King Jr. Day he sang “Never Give Up” live on *The View* with the gospel singer Yolanda Adams.

items.title: On the road with H.E.R.
items.text: He went on tour with H.E.R. When it ended, he went home and finished high school.

items.title: His own record
items.text: He released his first single, “This Ain’t It,” and directed the music video himself.

items.title: Sammie Moore
items.text: Ryan Coogler cast him as Sammie Moore in *Sinners*, opposite Michael B. Jordan. It was his first film role. He learned guitar for the part and sings much of the film’s music. That July he put out “Somethin” on his own.

items.title: Awards season, then Columbia
items.text: He was nominated for the BAFTA EE Rising Star Award, won Best Young Performer at the Critics’ Choice Awards, and sang “I Lied to You” with Raphael Saadiq at the 98th Academy Awards. In March he signed with Columbia Records and released “Don’t Hate Me.” “Lean On” followed in August.

items.title: What’s next
items.text: “Lean On” is out on Columbia. No new film or TV role has been announced.

intro: Miles Caton grew up in Brooklyn in a family of gospel singers. He was singing in church at two, went viral at twelve, toured with H.E.R. at seventeen and made his film debut at twenty. Within a year he was singing at the Oscars and signing with Columbia Records.
